column2: A bully repeatedly snatches a smaller child's schoolbag, leaving the distressed child reaching helplessly after it.
One child monopolizes all the building blocks, surrounding themselves with pieces while three companions wait empty-handed.
Two committee members discuss a proposed bridge model, pointing to different routes while colleagues consider their arguments.
A dying potted sapling has almost no leaves left, with a brittle drooping stem above dry cracked soil.
A child's drawing of a bicycle motivates a parent to repair the broken family bike beside their workbench.
A compact powered lawn mower stands halfway through a grassy strip, with clipped grass collected in its rear bag.
A careless cook muddles flour, utensils and recipe scraps together on a crowded counter, looking confused by the mess.
A person wraps a ringing alarm clock in a thick towel, leaving only a small part of its face exposed.
A person mulls over two possible house layouts, chin resting on a hand above the spread-out floor plans.
A child munches a crisp apple, taking a large bite while holding the fruit with both hands.
A rabbit chews steadily with puffed cheeks, holding a carrot while small jaw-motion marks emphasize the repeated chewing.
A strong pair of shears cuts a strip of fabric into separate pieces, with the blades midway through the material.
A magician's puzzled spectator stares into an empty hat, while the magician conceals a rabbit behind their back.
A mist-shrouded ruined temple has a softly glowing doorway and half-hidden carved pillars, creating a quiet mysterious atmosphere.
An adult nags a teenager about scattered shoes, pointing repeatedly at the untidy floor while the teenager sighs.
The mythic youth Narcissus kneels beside still water, captivated by his own reflection while nearby flowers go unnoticed.
Government officials take control of a factory from its private owner, replacing a company pennant with a plain civic crest.
A new citizen receives a citizenship document at a civic ceremony, standing proudly beside the administering official.
A wooden wagon wheel is shown close up, with spokes radiating into a thick central hub around the axle.
A reconstructed Neanderthal adult knaps a stone tool beside a fire, with a robust build and broad brow ridge.
A neglectful caretaker ignores a wilting plant while playing a handheld game beside its empty watering can.
A neoclassical building has a balanced facade, a triangular pediment and a row of classical columns around its entrance.
A neurosurgeon studies a brain scan beside a brain model, wearing operating scrubs in a tidy consultation room.
A compact newsstand displays folded newspapers and magazines beneath an awning, with covers showing pictures and unreadable lines.
Reporters gather around a newly rescued rare animal, photographing it while a wildlife worker presents the discovery.
Nomadic herders pack a portable tent onto a cart while guiding sheep toward new pasture, without stereotyped ethnic clothing.
A nonsmoker politely refuses an offered cigarette, raising a flat palm while holding a glass of water.
A child firmly declines an offered muddy boot, shaking their head and holding both palms outward.
A binary star system shows gas flowing from a large companion toward a compact star with a suddenly bright outer flare.
A bride and groom exchange wedding rings before a simple flower arch, with a small group of witnesses nearby.
A guardian makes a reluctant child take responsibility for a pet, handing them the food bowl beside the waiting dog.
An oceanographer lowers a water sampling instrument from a research vessel, with collected sea samples arranged on deck.
A small metal oilcan has a long narrow spout, thumb lever and rounded reservoir beside a squeaky door hinge.
An ancient city scene contains stone columns, a clay oil lamp and a horse cart, with no modern equipment.
A family cooks beside an old hearth using iron pots and a wooden churn, surrounded by simple premodern furnishings.
A surprised child has accidentally knocked a cup over, reaching too late as water spills across the table.
A boot sinks into soft wet ooze at a river margin, with thick mud bulging around its sole.
A composer arranges a melody for an orchestra, distributing separate music sheets among violin, flute and horn players.
A ruler establishes a new boundary by placing a ceremonial marker, while attendants align a rope along the declared line.
A very old tree still flourishes beside the decayed stumps of younger trees, with new leaves on its ancient branches.
A rope fence marks the limit of a garden, with one footpath stopping exactly at its outer boundary.
A fast cyclist overtakes a slower cyclist on a clear straight path, moving decisively ahead beside them.
An audience gives a standing ovation, many hands clapping toward a performer bowing at the front of the stage.
Too many passengers crowd into a small lift, pressing shoulder to shoulder while another tries to squeeze inside.
A customer offers two large coin stacks for a modest loaf, while the surprised baker returns most of the coins.
Many people squeeze into a tiny shared room, with closely packed beds and no clear personal space.
A factory conveyor produces more kettles than its overflowing warehouse can hold, with unsold boxes stacked beyond the shelves.
A judge awards an enormous trophy to a badly lopsided clay bowl, while a genuinely neat bowl is ignored.
A judge firmly rejects a lawyer's request with a raised palm, setting the submitted folder aside unopened.
An angler boasts with arms spread extremely wide, while the actual tiny fish rests in a bucket below.
A rusty iron nail lies beside a clean iron nail, with reddish flaky oxidation visibly spreading over the older surface.
A packer cushions a ceramic bowl inside a shipping box, folding protective paper neatly around its sides.
A diner looks tired of a once-favorite cake, pushing another identical slice away from an already crowded plate.
Two close friends walk with arms around each other's shoulders, sharing a cheerful private joke on a park path.
A parent excessively pampers a comfortable child, bringing sweets, cushions and toys while the child demands still more.
A pampered dog reclines on several cushions while its owner fans it and offers treats on a silver tray.
An overprotective adult surrounds a child on a tiny bicycle with pillows, preventing the child from moving freely.
One panelist speaks into a desk microphone among four seated discussants, facing an attentive studio audience.
Intense sun parches a shallow pond bed, leaving curled plant stems and wide cracks across the dry mud.
A narrow mountain path remains passable between fallen rocks, with a hiker carefully walking through the clear gap.
A historical patrician sits in a richly furnished hall, wearing fine formal robes while household attendants wait nearby.
A regular customer warmly greets the same bakery owner, carrying several familiar bread bags from that shop.
A smug adult pats another adult's head while offering unwanted help, with the recipient visibly uncomfortable at the condescension.
Light rain patters onto a broad leaf, making many small separate droplets bounce from its glossy surface.
A round minced-meat patty sizzles in a shallow frying pan, showing browned edges and a rough ground texture.
Peacekeepers stand between two tense opposing groups, using open hands and a neutral barrier to prevent renewed fighting.
A pedantic speaker points out tiny details in a thick book, ignoring the bored faces of the listening group.
A peddler walks door to door carrying baskets of household goods, showing a wooden spoon to a customer.
A pediatrician listens to a small child's chest with a stethoscope, while a caregiver holds the child's hand.
An unprocessed animal hide lies flat on a worktable, showing the hair side folded back over the raw underside.
A child pelts a sturdy wooden target with soft snowballs, one arm swinging forward beside a small ammunition pile.
A perfectionist adjusts a nearly perfect flower arrangement with tweezers, measuring tiny gaps while untouched bouquets wait nearby.
A tired child perks up when a puppy arrives, straightening suddenly with a broad smile and open arms.
A perky small dog springs eagerly toward its walking lead, ears raised and tail curled high with excitement.
A small stream peters out across dry gravel, narrowing into disconnected puddles before disappearing completely.
Plastic pellets, synthetic rubber tubing and a molded plastic container sit beside a small oil-refining model.
Old incandescent bulbs are gradually removed from a row of sockets, with efficient replacement bulbs occupying progressively more positions.
A single large lowercase Greek phi has a rounded loop crossed by one central vertical stroke, on transparency.
A full symphony orchestra performs together, with strings in front, winds behind and a conductor facing the musicians.
A cinema screen displays an adventure scene while seated viewers watch, with a film reel beside the projector.
A small pointed pick lifts a splinter from a wooden groove, showing its narrow shaft and easy-grip handle.
Raiders pillage an abandoned storehouse, carrying away sacks and overturned chests while broken shelves remain behind.
A concealed pit lies beneath thin branches on a walking path, shown in cutaway before an unaware hiker reaches it.
A caregiver comforts a crying child, kneeling at eye level and gently offering their recovered stuffed toy.
A music player displays a vertical playlist of album pictures with a play triangle beside the selected item; no titles.
A pointed metal plumb bob hangs from a taut string beside a wall, nearly touching the floor below.
A small airplane plunges steeply downward through clouds, with its nose pointed sharply below the horizon and no impact.
A protected plutonium specimen case sits behind thick shielding, with only the chemical symbol visible on its holder.
An egg poaches gently in barely simmering water, its white folding around the yolk as a slotted spoon lifts it.
Two practiced debaters use structured opposing arguments, pointing to arranged evidence cards across a formal debate table.
A politician addresses a small public gathering from a lectern, speaking earnestly while constituents raise their hands.
A scheming political operator trades favors behind a council chamber door, passing a sealed envelope while watching for witnesses.
A tadpole swims among pond plants, with a rounded dark head, long translucent tail and no developed legs.
A polluting factory operator dumps a barrel of dark waste into a clear stream, where fish retreat downstream.
An artisan dusts a freshly written parchment with fine pounce powder, shaking it from a small perforated container.
A power station houses a large turbine and generator, with cables leading toward a small nearby town.
A child returns a lost wallet intact to its owner, receiving warm applause from nearby adults.
An exceptionally skilled stone carver creates a flawless detailed sculpture, while simpler practice pieces remain on neighboring benches.
A picnic planner expects sunshine, imagining a sunny outing while actual rain clouds approach beyond the open window.
A proud novice displays a crude painting as though it were a masterpiece, posing grandly beside its oversized frame.
A luxurious handbag requires a towering pile of coins, while a simpler bag stands beside a much smaller pile.
A private business owner receives factory keys from a public official, exchanging the civic crest for a plain company pennant.
A gold prospector swirls river gravel in a shallow pan, examining tiny golden flakes beside a rocky stream.
A customs official places a barrier before imported crates while locally made goods move freely to the market stalls.
A protester raises a blank placard and a clenched fist outside a civic building, with other peaceful marchers behind.
A psychotherapist listens attentively to a seated client, with comfortable chairs facing each other in a quiet consultation room.
A purist baker rejects artificial flavoring bottles, choosing only vanilla pods and whole fresh ingredients for the bowl.
A pushy shopper thrusts past a queue toward the counter, leaning insistently over the waiting customers' shoulders.
A golfer makes a short controlled putt on the green, guiding the ball toward a nearby cup.
A business owner sits trapped between unpaid bills and an empty till, with creditors waiting at both sides of the desk.
A driving examiner grants a successful learner a license card, returning the car keys with an approving nod.
A judge renders a permit invalid by cutting its official ribbon, while an unused blank replacement remains aside.
Police contain a violent street disturbance behind shields, separating opposing groups without striking anyone or showing injuries.
A nervous singer's hands tremble around a microphone, with small motion marks around the shaking fingers.
A questioner raises one hand during a lecture, leaning forward while the speaker turns toward them.
A drill instructor signals a brisk march, and a small line of cadets steps forward together with lifted knees.
A goalkeeper reacts quickly to a low ball, springing sideways with both hands reaching toward it.
A small folded plug of chewing tobacco rests beside its open unbranded pouch, with no person consuming it.
An eccentric diner sorts peas into a perfect spiral before eating, while companions smile at the unusual habit.
A quitter abandons an almost finished puzzle, walking away while several easy pieces remain beside the board.
An oval horse-racing course curves around a grassy infield, with running horses approaching a clear finish post.
An athletics track has several curved lanes around a grass field, with runners rounding the nearest bend.
A cook recoils from a pot of rancid fat, covering their nose while holding the lifted lid away.
Two former friends glare bitterly at each other across a table, gripping opposite halves of a torn photograph.
A craftsperson rasps the edge of a wooden chair leg, with coarse wood shavings falling beneath the toothed tool.
A fierce storm has ravaged a small orchard, leaving snapped branches, uprooted saplings and scattered fruit across the ground.
An excited fan talks animatedly about a concert, waving a ticket while a patient friend listens beside them.
A marauder seizes a basket of food from a market stall, fleeing while the stallholder reaches after it.
A greedy wolf lunges toward an overflowing meat bowl, glaring at another wolf approaching the same food.
A demolition excavator reduces an empty derelict wall to rubble, with only a few low bricks left standing.
A rechargeable battery sits in a plugged-in charging cradle, with the power lead visibly connected to the socket.
A visitor steps back into a room they just left, turning through the same open doorway with a forgotten umbrella.
A returning spacecraft re-enters Earth's atmosphere, surrounded by a bright heat glow above the curved planet's surface.
An inspector rechecks a repaired bicycle wheel, testing the previously adjusted spoke beside the repair tools.
A child reforms scattered building blocks into a different tower, dismantling one side while rebuilding the central structure.
A tailor readjusts a previously pinned jacket sleeve, shifting the pins while the wearer stands before a mirror.
A real-estate agent presents a house and its enclosed garden, holding the property keys beside the front gate.
A hidden rabbit reappears from a magician's empty hat, surprising the same spectator standing beside the table.
A host gathers dispersed guests back around one picnic table, beckoning to people returning from opposite sides of the garden.
A librarian carefully records a specimen's details in a bound log, then files the page beside labeled-looking but unreadable drawers.
A shopkeeper recovers stolen coins from a returned purse, smiling with relief beside the previously empty cash tray.
An explorer rediscovers an overgrown stone doorway, brushing away vines while holding an old matching sketch of it.
A teacher redistributes unequal piles of crayons among four children, moving crayons from the largest pile to the smallest.
A worker restores a displaced statue to its original empty pedestal, aligning its base with the old mounting holes.
A conservation worker releases a native bird back into a woodland where its empty nesting box waits.
A wildlife team opens a transport crate to reintroduce several tortoises into their restored natural habitat.
A referee brings the same two boxers back into the ring for another match, with their previous trophy set aside.
An older adult reminisces over a childhood photograph, smiling softly while a thought bubble echoes the pictured playground.
Two hands rend a piece of cloth apart, pulling opposite edges until a long jagged tear opens between them.
A renter receives apartment keys from a landlord, carrying a suitcase toward the open rented room.
An official escorts a returning citizen from an aircraft toward waiting relatives in their home country, with luggage nearby.
A worn toothbrush head detaches from its handle, with an identical new replacement head positioned beside the connection.
Defenders repel attackers from a fortified gate using closed shields, forcing them backward without visible injury.
A planner moves a picture card for a meeting from one calendar square to another, leaving its old position empty.
An automatic door sensor responds to an approaching person by opening the sliding doors, with the sensor above clearly visible.
A road roller compresses fresh dark asphalt behind a paving machine, leaving a smooth resurfaced strip across an old road.
A fantasy healer revives a lifeless bird, which opens its eyes and lifts one wing within the healer's cupped hands.
A walker steps backward along a path, facing forward while their trailing foot moves toward their earlier footprints.
An early riser steps out of bed stretching, with slippers on the floor and dawn light entering the room.
A grassy riverbank slopes gently into flowing water, with exposed roots and reeds along the clear edge.
A roe deer stands at a woodland margin, showing its small slender body, short tail and white rump patch.
